claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GR-159897 is a potent, selective non-peptide NK2 (TACR2) tachykinin receptor antagonist with no intrinsic agonist activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since NK2 antagonism does not directly kill cancer cells and the only reported growth inhibition in breast carcinoma required 30 uM of the related NK1 antagonist.
